description:
## St. Mary's Hospital Lacor

**St. Mary's Hospital Lacor** is a private, non-profit hospital located in **Gulu City**, dedicated to providing quality and affordable healthcare services, especially to the most vulnerable members of society. The hospital has a long history of compassionate service in Northern Uganda and continues to grow its team of committed healthcare professionals.

We are inviting applications from qualified, competent and self-motivated individuals to join our team in the following position:

## Laboratory Technician (1 Position)

### About the Role

The Laboratory Technician will be responsible for performing diagnostic tests, operating and maintaining laboratory equipment, analysing specimens and reporting results to support patient diagnosis and treatment. This role requires a detail-oriented professional who can work independently and as part of a team in a busy hospital laboratory.

### Key Responsibilities

- Perform a wide range of laboratory tests including haematology, clinical chemistry, microbiology, parasitology and serology
- Operate, calibrate and maintain laboratory instruments and equipment to ensure accurate results
- Collect, receive, process and analyse specimens from patients and clinical departments
- Interpret test results and report findings to clinicians in a timely manner
- Ensure strict adherence to quality assurance protocols and participate in internal and external quality control programmes
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date laboratory records, logs and registers
- Follow infection prevention and control guidelines at all times
- Manage laboratory supplies, monitor stock levels and place orders when necessary
- Ensure proper handling, storage and disposal of biohazardous materials and chemical waste
- Train and supervise laboratory assistants and support staff
- Participate in diagnostic audits and contribute to continuous improvement in laboratory services
- Stay updated on new laboratory techniques, technologies and best practices

### Qualifications and Requirements

- **Degree or Bachelor's qualification** in medical laboratory science or a related field
- Must be registered with the Allied Health Professionals Council (AHPC) in Uganda
- Valid practising licence
- At least **3 years** of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
- Proficiency in operating modern laboratory equipment and diagnostic instruments
- Strong knowledge of laboratory safety standards and quality management systems
- Excellent analytical, organisational and communication skills
- Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
- Experience in a hospital laboratory is preferred

### How to Apply

Suitably qualified candidates should submit the following as a **single PDF document not exceeding 8MB**:

- Application letter
- Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Copies of academic documents and certificates
- Copy of AHPC registration and practising licence

📧 **Email:** vacancies@lacorhospital.org
   CC: it.office@lacorhospital.org

📬 **Postal address:**
The Deputy Administrator - Human Resources
St. Mary's Hospital Lacor
P.O. Box 180
Gulu, Uganda

### Important Information

- Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
- Any form of canvassing will lead to automatic disqualification
- St. Mary's Hospital Lacor is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from all qualified individuals
- No payments should be made during the application process

### Deadline

All applications must be received by **24th August 2026**.
